tested_scope: One deterministic local Node.js v22.16.0 control of the existing minimal escape-aware pre-materialization source-order scanner mechanism class using per-object-frame decoded-key exact seen/NFC state over exactly one fixed root-array JSON source with two sibling single-key objects: [{"é":1},{"e\u0301":2}]. mechanism: The scanner maintains a structural stack. Each object frame owns a fresh exact decoded-key seen set and NFC map. A source-order string token is treated as a key only when the next non-whitespace source character is a colon and the current top frame is an object. Exact or NFC-equivalent distinct-key collisions are checked only against the current object's maps; popping an object frame discards that object's key state before entering a sibling object.
inference: For this exact fixed source and scanner implementation, the first sibling object's NFC map is discarded when its object frame closes, so the second sibling object's distinct decoded key é is evaluated against a fresh NFC map and is accepted. This is consistent with object-local collision state rather than document-global NFC state. Together only with the immediately prior own-role same-object NFC-collision control, it distinguishes these two fixed cases; it does not establish arbitrary nested-object scoping or general JSON correctness.
